'''Smart sensor optics''' were a type of specialized [[Scope/Legends|scope]] that utilized advanced sensors to automatically adjust for windage, distance, and movement of target. These scopes made the marksman exceptionally accurate.<ref name="SACRIFICE" />

Smart sensor optics were used on modified [[Karpaki Fifty]] by the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], with one such being used by [[Ben Skywalker]] to assassinate [[Dur Gejjen]].<ref name="SACRIFICE" />
